# Android Studio project

This project is intentionally a safe, local-only WiFi security monitoring app.
It is designed to:
- scan nearby access points
- score network risk
- detect duplicate or suspicious SSIDs
- warn users about open or weakly protected networks
- store local scan history

It does not perform:
- packet capture
- credential theft
- deauth or jamming
- password brute force
- exploit or bypass behavior
